newsitem.title: KENYA: Two people shot dead in Kenya, policeman wounded.
newsitem.headline: Two people shot dead in Kenya, policeman wounded.

text.p: Police said two men were shot dead in disturbances in the Kenyan town of Nyahururu and a policeman was shot and wounded by a gunman in a crowd of protesters.

Police spokesman Assistant Commissioner Peter Kimanthi said a mob tried to storm the prison in Nyahururu, 100 km (60 miles) west of Nairobi, to free prisoners and one man was shot dead by prison authorities.
"Another group stormed the Cooperative Bank in the town and a man was shot dead by police," Kimanthi said. "A policeman was also shot and wounded in Nyahururu by someone shooting from the crowd."

Kimanthi said a boy was earlier killed in the town of Thika in an area where police were not active. He said police were investigating to find how he had died but journalists said they had reports he was shot dead and two other people were wounded.
Riot and paramilitary police fired tear gas and rubber bullets to break up demonstrations in the capital Nairobi. Scores of protesters were severely beaten, some even after they surrendered.
